jei.template_mod.speed_upgrade: Installed into the 10 upgrade slots of the Chishi Generator (single, Assembly or Super Architecture), one per slot. Each boosts output speed x1.75 but cuts yield by 1%%, up to 10 (max ~x242).
gui.template_mod.super_generator.formed_: Complete: 200x burn speed, total fuel energy x3 of a single generator
jei.template_mod.life_purifier: Solidifies Life Energy into a solid form. Feed Chi Energy (up to 1M/t) and Life Energy; each operation consumes 10M Chi + 1000 Life Energy to produce 1 Life Essence Solid. The output slot works with hoppers, AE2 and Item Pipes.
jei.template_mod.life_essence_solid: Life Energy solidified through Chishi refinement. A basic material for Life research; its uses will be revealed in later chapters.
jei.template_mod.sample_collector: A portable life-energy vessel. Right-click a creature to extract its life sample (weaker creatures are easier: ≤50% HP +10%, ≤25% +10% more, capped 95%); right-click life blocks/pipes to recharge. Purity leans low: 60% 0-49, 25% 50-74, 15% 75-100.
jei.template_mod.life_sample: Genetic material drawn from a living creature, carrying purity and source. Purity ≥25 feeds the Gene Analyzer; lower purity goes to the Potion Table. Purity drives the whole chain: sequence → organ integrity → rejection.
jei.template_mod.gene_sequence: The product of deconstructing a purity ≥25 sample. Keeps the sample's purity. The Life Structure Table builds organs from it: integrity = purity − random loss (0-20); 100→III, 50-99→II, <50→I.
jei.template_mod.potion: Bio-potion carrying a Permanent/Breakthrough template. Inherits source and purity: Permanent is stable with no side effects; Breakthrough multiplies effects ×1.5 but amplifies side effects (worse with low purity).
jei.template_mod.organ: An organ to implant (one per body slot). Quality and integrity set its power; rejection = quality × creature group × integrity modifier. Rejection grows over time (doubled below adaptation 60, ×1.6 for End/Dragon). Enemy pairs max it out and explode back.
jei.template_mod.gene_analyzer: Deconstructs purity ≥25 samples into gene sequences: 5,000 life energy, 5 seconds. Success scales with purity (70% at 25, 95% at 100); failure loses the sample.
jei.template_mod.cultivator: Strengthens samples and organs. Purify: +10 purity per run in four tiers (90/80/70/60% success, 1/2/4/8 solids and 10/20/40/80K energy). Upgrade: quality I→IV (85/75/65%; failure keeps the organ).
jei.template_mod.life_struct: Builds organs from gene sequences: 1 sequence + 5 solids + 80,000 life energy, 6 seconds. Integrity = purity − random loss (0-20), setting quality tier and adaptation.
jei.template_mod.surgery: Organ implant chamber. Implant: 3 solids + 20,000 energy, 4 seconds (target slot free and organ must match); Extract: 1 solid + 5,000 energy, organ returns to inventory.
jei.template_mod.potion_table: Brews potions: purity ≥25 sample + solids + life energy → Permanent/Breakthrough potion. Cost depends on the template; product inherits source and purity.
jei.template_mod.sample_vault: Large sample warehouse (54 slots): accepts samples only, identical ones auto-merge, supports pipes. Place within 3 blocks of an Analyzer/Potion Table to link access.
jei.template_mod.organ_vault: Body-slot paged organ freezer (9 pages × 9 slots + 9 buffer): organs auto-sort into their slot's page; drains 1 life energy/tick to stay active. Place near a Surgery Chamber etc. to link access.
jei.template_mod.potion_cabinet: Large potion warehouse (54 slots): potions only, auto-merge by template and purity, template filter and pipes supported. Place within 3 blocks of a Potion Table to link access.
jei.template_mod.reactor_controller: The Reactor Controller is the heart of the multiblock reactor. Build a closed box (side 5 or 7, 1-block thick walls) from Reactor Shells, put the Controller and ports on the walls, and 1 Core, Fuel Rods (≤10) and Coolers (≤20) inside. Feed Fuel Cells into the fuel slots; output peaks at 400-700℃. Above 850℃ it enters an overheat warning with reduced output (no shutdown); at 1000℃ full heat it explodes after 10 seconds, spawning a 5-chunk decay zone (decay debuff / wasteland / mutation). Breaking the reactor or its structure at full heat leaks a decay zone too.
jei.template_mod.reactor_shell: Reactor Shell: wall material of the multiblock reactor. Build a closed box of side 5 or 7 with all six faces complete for the structure to form.
jei.template_mod.reactor_fuel_rod: Fuel Rod: place inside the reactor; each unlocks one fuel slot (max 10). Only Coolers adjacent to a Fuel Rod count.
jei.template_mod.reactor_cooler: Cooler: place inside the reactor, right-click to insert a Heat Sink. Effective only when adjacent to a Fuel Rod; burns 1 sink durability per tick while active.
jei.template_mod.reactor_core: Reactor Core: the burning heart of the reactor. The interior must contain exactly one, or the structure won't form.
jei.template_mod.reactor_fuel_port: Fuel Port: place on the reactor wall. Has a 27-slot buffer that auto-feeds Fuel Cells to the controller and returns empty ones.
jei.template_mod.reactor_energy_output: Energy Output: place on the reactor wall. Generator-only output (5B buffer); energy pipes can extract but cannot charge it back. Right-click to view stored energy.
jei.template_mod.reactor_waste_port: Waste Port: place on the reactor wall. Export-only - pushes Exhausted Life Fuel into fluid pipes (route it to an Exhausted Barrel).
jei.template_mod.exhausted_barrel: Exhausted Barrel: 1,000,000 mb tank for Exhausted Life Fuel. Pipes can insert and extract; shows a liquid level gauge.
jei.template_mod.heat_sink: Heat Sink: effective when installed in a Cooler adjacent to a Fuel Rod. Poor 1%/36k ticks, Normal 2%/72k, Good 3%/108k, Fine 4%/144k, Exquisite 5%/180k; loses 1 durability per burning tick and shatters at zero (unrepairable).
jei.template_mod.end_mixture: End Mixture: crafted from Ender Eye + Shulker Shell + Chorus Fruit. Liquefied into End Mixture Fuel (utilization 4, 600k/t per slot).
jei.template_mod.dragon_mixture: Dragon Mixture: crafted from Dragon's Breath + End Crystal + Obsidian. Liquefied into Dragon Fuel (utilization 7, 1.05M/t per slot).
jei.template_mod.sculk_lifeform: Sculk Lifeform: crafted from Echo Shard + Sculk Block + Golden Apple + Chishi Essence Block. Liquefied into Sculk Life Fuel (utilization 2, 300k/t per slot).
jei.template_mod.fuel_cell: Fuel Cell: filled with liquid fuel by the Fuel Canner, 10 L (10,000 mb) capacity, not stackable once filled. Place in a reactor fuel slot to burn.
jei.template_mod.energy_liquefier: Energy Liquefier: liquefies Nether Stars, Wither Roses and the three mixtures into liquid energies and fuels (some recipes need Life Essence Solids).
jei.template_mod.energy_processor: Energy Processor: refines pure/compound liquid energy into Pure Fuel and Nether Compound Fuel for advanced mixing.
jei.template_mod.fuel_canner: Fuel Canner: fills Fuel Cells with liquid fuel (10,000 mb each) for reactors and other machines.
jei.template_mod.fuel_mixer: Fuel Mixer: blends fuels: End Mixture + Nether Compound → Advanced Mixture (utilization 5); Dragon + Pure → Ultimate Mixture (utilization 10, 1.5M/t per slot).
jei.template_mod.item_pipe_basic: Logistics relay: transports items across a pipe network to connected containers/machines. Basic: 1 item/tick. Use the Chishi Configurator to toggle Push/Pull modes or disconnect a side.
jei.template_mod.item_pipe_advanced: Logistics relay: transports items across a pipe network to connected containers/machines. Advanced: 4 items/tick.
jei.template_mod.item_pipe_elite: Logistics relay: transports items across a pipe network to connected containers/machines. Elite: 16 items/tick.
jei.template_mod.item_pipe_ultimate: Logistics relay: transports items across a pipe network to connected containers/machines. Ultimate: 64 items/tick for mass transfer.
jei.template_mod.catalyst_basic: Consumes Chishi Energy to grow crystal clusters on Geodes in range. Range 3x3x3, 20% chance, 5 E/t.
jei.template_mod.catalyst_medium: Consumes Chishi Energy to grow crystal clusters on Geodes in range. Range 5x5x5, 30% chance, 25 E/t.
jei.template_mod.catalyst_advanced: Consumes Chishi Energy to grow crystal clusters on Geodes in range. Range 9x9x9, 40% chance, 125 E/t.
jei.template_mod.catalyst_ultimate: Consumes Chishi Energy to grow crystal clusters on Geodes in range. Range 16x16x16, 50% chance, 625 E/t.
jei.template_mod.collector_basic: Auto-harvests clusters, storing essence in a 27-slot container. Range 3x3x3, 30 ticks/cluster, 2 E/t. Works with hoppers, AE2 & Mekanism pipes.
jei.template_mod.collector_medium: Auto-harvests clusters, storing essence in a 27-slot container. Range 5x5x5, 15 ticks/cluster, 4 E/t. Works with hoppers, AE2 & Mekanism pipes.
jei.template_mod.collector_advanced: Auto-harvests clusters, storing essence in a 27-slot container. Range 9x9x9, 7 ticks/cluster, 8 E/t. Works with hoppers, AE2 & Mekanism pipes.
jei.template_mod.collector_ultimate: Auto-harvests clusters, storing essence in a 27-slot container. Range 16x16x16, 2 ticks/cluster, 16 E/t. Works with hoppers, AE2 & Mekanism pipes.

Fuel is injected via fuel input ports (pipes/hoppers), energy is drawn via energy output ports (pipes only). Data is preserved when blocks are mined and kept when re-placed.

Data is preserved when blocks are mined and kept when re-placed.
